title: Sum of the Digits

concept.title: Peeling a number digit by digit
body: You already know the two moves: `n % 10` reads the last digit and `n / 10` removes it. Put them in a while loop and every digit of the number passes by, from right to left.

body.code:
while n > 0:
    digit = n % 10     # look at the last digit
    ...                # do something with it
    n = n // 10        # remove it

body: What you do with each digit is the point of the exercise: add it to a total (this problem), count it, compare it with others, or build a new number from it (the next problem).
Here the accumulator is the sum of the digits, starting at 0. The case `n = 0` needs no special treatment: the loop does not run and the sum stays 0, which is the right answer.

statement: Given a non-negative integer `n`, print the sum of its digits.
hints: Read the last digit with `n % 10` and add it to a total.
Then remove the last digit with `n / 10` and repeat while `n` is greater than 0.
The total starts at 0, which also gives the right answer for `n = 0`.

explanation: Each round adds the last digit to the total and removes it. When no digits are left the loop ends and the total is printed.
solution.complexity: Time O(d) where d is the number of digits (at most 19), space O(1).

code.python:
n = int(input())

total = 0
while n > 0:
    total += n % 10
    n = n // 10
print(total)
